purpose: Freeze the sole Campaign145 cumulative return-amount path-area definition, accepted source, complete comparison boundary, ordered no-return gates, one development trial, execution assumptions and stop rules before opening any Campaign145 value.

candidate.name: intraday_return_amount_cumulative_path_signed_area_238p
candidate.economic_hypothesis: Positive return innovation arriving after transaction-amount mass within each half-session represents activity-led price discovery and may carry continuation over the next three sessions.

exact_formula.return_increments: Within each half only, r_i=ln(close_i/close_{i-1}); require all 120 closes finite and strictly positive and sum_i(abs(r_i))>0; dx_i=r_i/sum_j(abs(r_j)).
exact_formula.amount_increments: Use the nonnegative finite amount at each return destination; require the 119 endpoint amounts in each half to have positive sum; dy_i=a_i/sum_j(a_j).
exact_formula.cumulative_paths: Start X_0=Y_0=0 and set X_i=sum_{j<=i}(dx_j), Y_i=sum_{j<=i}(dy_j) independently inside each half.
exact_formula.support: Both halves must satisfy every close, amount and positive-denominator condition and produce finite half scores; exact zero returns and zero endpoint amounts remain valid increments; otherwise the stock-day is missing.

comparison_contract.direction_normalization: use every comparator's frozen score direction

ordered_no_return_gates.name: binding_source_snapshot_formula_and_implementation_verification
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Before source values, bind this protocol, pure formula, tests, raw source, joint-clean identity, builder, verifier, ordered audit and output paths. After publication verify every partition byte/frame hash, exact projection/grid/formula/support/range/count and aggregate dataset digest.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: structural_coverage_variation_and_capacity_before_comparator_values
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: On the immutable quality/current-listing base require median daily coverage >=0.95, P05 daily coverage >=0.90, P05 eligible names >=50, at least 200 non-overlapping three-signal-session cohorts, at least five observed years, finite values in [-1,1], and at least 200 nonconstant cross-sectional sessions. Failure stops before comparator values, daily prices or forward returns.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: all_141_numeric_uniqueness_after_coverage_only
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Compare in exact v190 numeric order with all 141 eligible numeric comparators. Each comparison requires at least 50 paired names per session and at least 100 qualifying sessions. Every absolute median daily average-tie Spearman rank correlation must be strictly below 0.8; insufficient overlap fails closed and no comparator may be removed.

finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.purge: Purge three signal sessions at every train/validation boundary; t+1 entry and t+3 exit must remain in the same partition.
finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.execution: Reuse the frozen one-factor next-open to third-close Top-3 engine, CNY 200000 board-lot pilot, quality/listing gates, amount-participation checks, 0/5/10/20bp stress grid and survivor gates without override.
finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.stress_2024_2025: Open once for the whole campaign only if the sole trial survives every 2019-2023 development gate and a nonzero survivor record freezes the entire campaign; label it historically exposed quasi-out-of-sample. Otherwise leave it closed and unread.

next_action: Implement and synthetically test the exact pure formula without opening historical source values, then fingerprint-freeze code and tests before the single no-return snapshot build.
